_readme: Ticket agents (lib/ticket_agents.py). mode: auto = propose until act_after, then act | propose | act | off. agents: per-agent override. stale_claims and refeed stay on 'propose' until you change them here: releasing claims can re-queue tickets that were deliberately held, and refeed opens a second PR beside the denied one. A ticket labelled pinned is never touched; held also protects its claim. project_tag acts from the start (Gil 2026-10-08, ADR 0060): it only adds a project: label, never removes one, never re-adds one a person took off, and every change is in the audit log. triage acts from 2026-10-09 (Gil: 53 open tickets had no state, so nothing flowed).
